spots.name: Outdoor Pool
spots.description: Our heated saltwater pool is the perfect spot to unwind under the Okanagan sun. Temperature-controlled for your comfort, with poolside loungers and a panoramic view of the lake. Outdoor pool open May long weekend to September. A favourite gathering spot for owners and guests alike.

spots.name: Spa, Fitness & Hot Tub
spots.description: The Oasis Spa & Fitness building features an oversized adult hot tub surrounded by private hedging, indoor showers to use after using the fitness room or hot tub, and a relaxation patio. The fitness centre is fully equipped with treadmills, recumbent bikes, a multi-station universal gym, free weights, stability balls, and a dedicated stretching area. The spa and fitness are open year-round and are fully air-conditioned.

spots.name: Beach & Boat Launch
spots.description: Step onto your own private sandy beach on Lake Osoyoos — Canada's warmest freshwater lake. The beach features a dedicated boat launch, floating swim platform, and dock facility. The lake stretches fourteen miles, half in the USA and half in Canada, perfect for swimming, kayaking, and paddleboarding.

spots.name: Main Washrooms & Laundry
spots.description: Our main washroom facilities feature nice fibreglass showers for both men's and women's use. The laundry room is equipped with three washers and three dryers for the convenience of all resort owners and guests.

spots.name: Club & Recreation Hall
spots.description: The heart of the Oasis — our centrally located club hall hosts community dinners, holiday celebrations, game nights, and social gatherings throughout the year. Fully equipped kitchen, sound system, and a covered patio make it the ideal venue for any occasion.

spots.name: Playground
spots.description: Two dedicated play areas keep young families entertained — a shaded in-park playground with climbing structures and swings, and a separate beachside play zone right on the sand. Both areas feature modern, safety-certified equipment surrounded by mature trees.

spots.name: The Lounge
spots.description: Attached to the manager's residence, the lounge is a comfortable space where you can have coffee, watch TV, use the WiFi to work on your laptop, and there is popcorn for the kids. Open May to October. Not fully air-conditioned.
